title: QuantaAlpha: LLM-Driven Evolutionary Framework for Alpha Factor Mining
tldr: QuantaAlpha combines LLMs with evolutionary algorithms for automated Alpha factor mining via multi-agent collaboration, achieving IC 0.1501 and 27.75% annualized excess return on CSI 300, significantly outperforming benchmarks.
abstract: QuantaAlpha is an evolutionary framework for LLM-driven Alpha factor mining, proposed by a multi-university team and published on arXiv in February 2026. The framework integrates large language models with evolutionary algorithms, using multi-agent collaboration to simulate professional quantitative researchers' workflow. It covers hypothesis generation, factor construction, code implementation, backtesting, and iterative optimization. Three agent types (Idea Agent, Factor Agent, Evaluation Agent) transform hypotheses into executable factors via symbolic expression and AST, ensuring semantic consistency. The framework achieves trajectory-level directed evolution, replacing random trial-and-error. On CSI 300, it achieves IC 0.1501, annualized excess return 27.75%, and maximum drawdown 7.98%, far surpassing Alpha158, AlphaAgent, and RD-Agent benchmarks.
strategy: QuantaAlpha automates Alpha factor mining by integrating LLMs with evolutionary algorithms [source: "构建'提出假设→构建因子→回测检验→迭代优化→因子池维护'一体化自动因子挖掘体系"]. 1) Hypothesis generation: LLM generates 10 independent, complementary hypotheses based on price-volume divergence, volatility, momentum, and microstructure for parallel mining to avoid local optima [source: "生成10个具备明确金融逻辑、相互独立且彼此互补的初始投资假设"]. 2) Factor implementation: Three agents (Idea, Factor, Evaluation) transform hypotheses into structured factors via symbolic expression and AST with three-layer constraints [source: "三类智能体协同，将假设转为结构化因子，经符号化与AST转化并施加三重约束"]. 3) Iterative optimization: LLM-directed evolution replaces random trial-and-error; mutation fixes failing steps while preserving valid logic; crossover recombines quality logic at hypothesis level [source: "LLM主导定向进化，精准修正失效环节、交叉复用优质逻辑"]. 4) Factor screening: Rank IC ranking, correlation ≤0.7, and 50% pool capacity ensure quality and diversity [source: "设置Rank IC、低冗余、容量三重门槛，择优纳入因子库"].
method: QuantaAlpha uses a multi-agent architecture driven by LLM (GPT-5.2). The Idea Agent refines research directions into executable hypotheses [source: "将粗粒度宏观研究方向，细化为可落地、可执行的结构化投资假设"]. The Factor Agent converts hypotheses into mathematical expressions via symbolic representation and AST, then compiles into executable code [source: "采用'符号化表达+抽象语法树(AST)'的方式，先将假设转化为标准数学表达式，经结构校验后再编译为可执行代码"]. Three constraints enforce quality: semantic consistency, complexity control (expression ≤250 chars, free parameters <50%, raw features ≤6), and redundancy control via structural matching [source: "语义一致性约束...复杂度约束...冗余性约束：通过结构匹配过滤高度相似因子"]. The Evaluation Agent backtests via Qlib, recording metrics into trajectory archives. For evolution, mutation involves LLM retrospecting trajectories to pinpoint failing steps [source: "由LLM回溯整条研究轨迹，精准定位导致失效的关键步骤，仅对问题部分进行修正"]. Crossover extracts core logic from high-performing trajectories and recombines at hypothesis level [source: "提取各自的核心精华片段...在投资假设层面进行有意义的逻辑组合与重构"].
experiment: The experiment uses CSI 300 as the target stock pool, with training period 2016-2020 and test period 2022-2025, employing GPT-5.2 as the core LLM [source: "论文实证以沪深300为研究标的，训练集2016-2020年，测试集2022-2025年，采用GPT-5.2作为核心大语言模型"]. Six daily price-volume features (open, high, low, close, volume, vwap) are used with approximately 60 operators across 6 categories [source: "基础特征: open/high/low/close/volume/vwap（6个日频价量特征）...算子库: 6类约60个算子"]. The backtest uses TopKDropout holding top 50 stocks, with about 15 evolution rounds and optimal performance at 350 factors [source: "回测策略: TopKDropout，每期持有Top50只股票...350个因子时表现最优"]. Benchmarks include Alpha158, AlphaAgent, and RD-Agent. For cross-market validation, factors are applied to CSI 500 and S&P 500. The reproduction used Qwen3.5-plus with 13 directions, mining 21 factors with corrected data splits to avoid leakage [source: "以2016-2021年数据完成全流程因子挖掘，2022-2025年作为完全独立的样本外验证窗口"].
result: On CSI 300, QuantaAlpha achieves IC 0.1501, Rank IC 0.1465, annualized return 27.75%, maximum drawdown 7.98%, IR 332.51%, and Calmar ratio 347.74%, outperforming AlphaAgent (IC 9.66%, ARR 15.54%, MDD 12.89%) and RD-Agent (IC 5.31%, ARR 9.91%, MDD 14.82%) [source: "IC达0.1501，年化超额收益27.75%，最大回撤仅7.98%"]. Cross-market application to CSI 500 and S&P 500 yields 130%-160% cumulative excess return over four years [source: "四年累计超额收益达130%160%"]. Optimal performance at 350 factors (11-12 rounds). Reproduction with Qwen3.5-plus yielded 21 factors with stock selection ability but low ICIR and high volatility, due to insufficient mining scale vs. 350 factors [source: "因子虽具备一定选股能力，但ICIR偏低、组合波动较大，信号尚显稚嫩"].
